title: McMurdo Station
summary: McMurdo Station is the largest station in Antarctica, on volcanic rock at Hut Point Peninsula, Ross Island. The US set it up in December 1955 and it opened in 1956 under Operation Deep Freeze; it now serves as the logistics hub of the US Antarctic Program.

uncertainty.note: Established 18 December 1955 and opened in 1956 per NSF.
